stem: A DEA-registered outpatient clinic stores Schedule II–V controlled substances on site. Which storage practice best aligns with federal DEA requirements?

options.A: Store Schedule II–V substances on open shelving inside a locked clinic room because the locked room alone satisfies the cabinet requirement.
options.B: Keep Schedule II–V substances in an unlocked medication cart during operating hours when licensed clinicians are working on the unit.
options.C: Use one shared access key for all employees so medications remain available while access restrictions are handled through end-of-day inventory.
options.D: Store Schedule II–V controlled substances in a securely locked, substantially constructed cabinet or other storage meeting applicable DEA security requirements.

rationale: DEA guidance applying 21 CFR 1301.75(b) states that controlled substances stored at a practitioner's registered location must be kept in a securely locked, substantially constructed cabinet, subject to applicable DEA security requirements. DEA also states that Schedule II–V controlled substances may be stored in a safe or securely locked, substantially constructed cabinet. D is correct.
educational_objective: Apply federal DEA physical-security requirements by storing Schedule II–V controlled substances in securely locked, substantially constructed storage that meets applicable DEA requirements.

audit_findings.exact_locator: DEA Civil Unrest Q&A, Practitioners and Pharmacy sections citing 21 CFR 1301.75(b)
audit_findings.claim_audit: Final item states the federal storage requirement without expanding it into unsupported staffing or key-sharing rules.

distractor_audit.A: Incorrect because open shelving does not satisfy the cited cabinet/storage requirement merely because the room is locked.
distractor_audit.B: Incorrect because an unlocked cart does not satisfy secure locked-storage requirements.
distractor_audit.C: Incorrect because unrestricted shared-key access is inconsistent with controlled-substance security and does not substitute for compliant storage.
distractor_audit.D: Correct and directly supported by DEA guidance and the cited regulation.

audit_findings.ambiguity_second_answer: Only D states the applicable DEA storage standard.
audit_findings.cueing: All options are storage/access practices; the key is determined by the regulatory requirement.
